title: CFEDemands: estimation and computation of Constant Frisch Elasticity demand systems
description:
Tools for estimating and computing Constant Frisch Elasticity (CFE) demand systems. The CFE demand system delivers demands that are linear in the logarithm of the marginal utility of expenditure, which makes estimation tractable in household panel data with unobserved heterogeneity and permits welfare and demand counterfactuals to be computed directly from estimated elasticities.

The package is distributed on PyPI as CFEDemands and imported as cfe.
